messages:
Ashley: Quick check — Pollux enterprise POC: need final list of integration deliverables, owners, and success criteria by EOD Thu. Sequence: staging integration -> canary traffic -> UAT signoff. Who's taking which piece?
Mario: I'll own the webhook adapter + retry semantics. ETA Wed noon. @Ashley i'll post schema in #docs after lunch.
Sophia: I'll take model mapping + prompt templates. Can we confirm tokenizer/version? Last synced to rwd-llama-3-7b.
Devon: Eng will handle staging infra and canary routing. Need the expected QPS and concurrency targets. Pollux said 50 rps steady, 200 peak bursts.
Samir: Success criteria: 1) end-to-end latency < 400ms p95 for generation, 2) embeddings match baseline examples, 3) no PII exfil in logs. OK?
Ashley: Yes. Add retention/PII gating for Private plan. Also need SLO for error budgets.
Mario: schema posted: https://redwood.docs/pollux/schema-v1.md
Sophia: tokenizer confirmed: rwd-tokenizer v2.2; will add prompt tests to eval harness.
Devon: Infra notes — provisioning VM pool for canary. infra-bot scheduled deployment window.
Infra-Bot: Deployment scheduled: staging -> 2024-11-08 03:00 UTC, canary -> 2024-11-09 04:00 UTC. ETA for pool ready: 6h.
Ashley: Can owners drop any blockers now? List next steps:
- Mario: webhook adapter + schema hookup
- Sophia: prompt templates + eval sets
- Devon: staging infra + canary routing
- Samir: success criteria doc + customer-runbook
Mario: no blockers from my side. Need a cert for pollux-staging domain.
Devon: I'll request cert from infra ops; ping me if it's urgent.
Samir: I'll draft the runbook and share a link by Thu EOD.
Ashley: Great. If anyone needs help, @here. We'll do async check-in Friday morning. :thumbsup:
